name: Yokitup
description:
Yokitup is a restaurant inventory and operations management platform designed for restaurant operators and managers.

The Yokitup MCP server connects Claude to operational data so users can explore, analyze and better understand their restaurant performance using natural language.

Claude can access data such as products, recipes, food costs, inventories, stock losses and waste, stock transfers, and sales. It can combine information from different areas of the business to answer operational questions, identify trends and highlight anomalies.

For example, users can ask Claude to identify the products generating the highest losses, analyze food costs and margins, review inventory data, investigate stock movements, compare sales with operational data, or compare performance across locations.

The integration is particularly useful for restaurant groups and multi-site operators who need to analyze large amounts of operational data without manually exporting and combining reports.

Yokitup helps restaurant teams turn inventory, recipe, cost and sales data into actionable insights, with a particular focus on controlling food costs, understanding margins and improving operational performance.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Yokitup to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Yokitup to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.yokitup.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Yokitup MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yokitup lists 31 MCP tools, including analyze_food_cost, analyze_losses, analyze_pos_sales, analyze_purchases, analyze_stock_movements, analyze_supplier_product_prices, explain_inventory_valuation, explain_inventory_variance, get_current_organization, get_current_stock, get_inventory, and get_loss.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Yokitup?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Yokitup in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Yokitup requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Yokitup is developed by Yokitup. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
